notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: אפים em i ol susu bilong nogut — 'ol nus' bilong pes; Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim pasin kros, klostu long wanem man i save ting long olgeta samting.

notes.subject: ארך אפים
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'ol nus i longpela' — em i bilong tok 'em i no kros kwik'; luksave long pasin bilong tok nogut.

notes.subject: Yahwe Yahwe
notes.rationale: Nem i tok tupela taim — strongpela pasin bilong karautim; Tok Pisin i holim tu.

notes.subject: karautim nem
notes.rationale: Nem bilong Yahwe i opim nau — olgeta tok bilong em i stap long ves 6–7, i no long wanpela tok 'God' tasol.

translation: Na Yahwe i go pas long pes bilong em, na em i karautim: Yahwe, Yahwe, El i gat marimari, i gutpela bel, i no kros kwik, i gutpela tru long khesed na long tru.
